mapper.select: SELECT STAFF_SQ, STAFF_NM, RRN_ENC, POSITION_NM, DEPT_NM, ORG_NM, JOIN_DT, EMAIL FROM TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M
SELECT EMPLY_EMAIL FROM TB_EEP_EMPLY_M WHERE EMPLY_ID = #{EMPLY_ID}

SELECT C.FROM_NM, C.FROM_ADDR, C.APP_PW_ENC, C.REPLY_TO, C.BCC, C.CONTACT, C.SUBJECT, C.BODY, C.VERIFIED_YN , DATE_FORMAT(C.VERIFIED_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS VERIFIED_DT FROM TB_EEP_PAYSLIP_MAIL_M C WHERE C.CONF_SQ = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_PAYSLIP_MAIL_M SET SUBJECT = #{SUBJECT}, BODY = #{BODY}, UPDT_EMPLY_ID = #{EMPLY_ID} WHERE CONF_SQ = 1
UPDATE TB_EEP_PAYSLIP_MAIL_M SET VERIFIED_YN = #{VERIFIED_YN}, VERIFIED_DT = IF(#{VERIFIED_YN} = 'Y', NOW(), NULL) WHERE CONF_SQ = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_PAYSLIP_CONF_H (KIND_CD, SUMMARY, SUBJECT, BODY, EMPLY_ID) VALUES (#{KIND_CD}, #{SUMMARY}, #{SUBJECT}, #{BODY}, #{EMPLY_ID})
mapper.select: SELECT H.HIST_SQ, H.KIND_CD, H.SUMMARY, DATE_FORMAT(H.REG_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS REG_DT, H.EMPLY_ID , (SELECT E.EMPLY_NM FROM TB_EEP_EMPLY_M E WHERE E.EMPLY_ID = H.EMPLY_ID LIMIT 1) AS EMPLY_NM FROM TB_EEP_PAYSLIP_CONF_H H ORDER BY H.HIST_SQ DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT SUBJECT, BODY FROM TB_EEP_PAYSLIP_CONF_H WHERE HIST_SQ = #{HIST_SQ} AND KIND_CD = 'BODY'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_PAYSLIP_LOG_H (PAY_YM, STAFF_SQ, CHANNEL, TO_ADDR, RESULT, ERROR_MSG, EMPLY_ID) VALUES (#{YM}, #{STAFF_SQ}, #{CHANNEL}, #{TO_ADDR}, #{RESULT}, #{ERROR_MSG}, #{EMPLY_ID})
mapper.select: SELECT L.STAFF_SQ, L.CHANNEL, L.RESULT, DATE_FORMAT(L.REG_DT, '%m-%d %H:%i') AS REG_DT FROM TB_EEP_PAYSLIP_LOG_H L WHERE L.PAY_YM = #{YM} AND L.LOG_SQ = (SELECT MAX(X.LOG_SQ) FROM TB_EEP_PAYSLIP_LOG_H X WHERE X.PAY_YM = L.PAY_YM AND X.STAFF_SQ = L.STAFF_SQ)

SELECT L.CHANNEL, L.TO_ADDR, L.RESULT, L.ERROR_MSG, DATE_FORMAT(L.REG_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS REG_DT , (SELECT E.EMPLY_NM FROM TB_EEP_EMPLY_M E WHERE E.EMPLY_ID = L.EMPLY_ID LIMIT 1) AS EMPLY_NM FROM TB_EEP_PAYSLIP_LOG_H L WHERE L.PAY_YM = #{YM} AND L.STAFF_SQ = #{STAFF_SQ} ORDER BY L.LOG_SQ DESC
